decisions.statement: When activation is high, pause and orient before deciding what it means. No fixed breath count is required.
Tentative conclusions may be formed during activation when doing so creates no safety issue, and those conclusions must be re-evaluated when calm.
Treat best-friend advice as a draft and retain only what is compassionate, feasible, value-consistent, and compatible with the person's own judgment.
The Protector may pause an immediately unsafe impulse and seek support while the underlying feeling remains permitted.

Do not create parts unless that model is useful. Do not over-separate or over-integrate internal positions because of a map or model. The useful model is dynamic and may change from one moment to the next.
Prefer truthful, bounded promises of protection and repair. After a lapse, return and repair rather than promising invulnerability.
Worth is intrinsic, while adult capacities can be developed through practice.
When possible, close inner work deliberately by reorienting, noticing the body, and naming the next ordinary action; do not impose a fixed ritual.
Review is critical. Notice recognition, repair, missed and kept promises, and what should change next without turning review into a trial. No mandatory morning/evening cadence is established.

Common-humanity guidance is not optional: the person is not alone in suffering, and connection with others who are healing can support mutual peer healing. This must not minimize the person's particular trauma.
During a meaningful transition or ending, name what ended, what remains unknown, and how adult and child remain together through the gap.
Retire 'forgiveness only when useful.' Preserve the existing distinction that forgiveness does not erase harm or weaken accountability, boundaries, consequences, distance, or no-contact.
Some people whose identity is underdeveloped may need preference and selfhood development before no-self or surrender practices are useful; this is not a universal prerequisite.
Retire the universal 'every session ends' wording and use the flexible, qualified closure guidance in D08.
Retire all 57 manual Mermaid arrows as executable topology. Preserve them in the migration ledger and generate only exact compiled edges and explicit documentation-overlay relationships.
